exercises.title: Complete the sentences with the words in the box.

sentences.text: Be careful on your bicycle today. It’s very cold and the water on the road is solid _____.
The desert is hot and very _____ because there isn’t much rain.
There are _____ in many areas this morning, so take your umbrellas.
We’re stopping our hockey match because a _____ is coming. Look, the sky is black!
Temperatures are below _____ in many parts of the country, with snow in some places.
There’s a lot of rain in the north today. The _____ weather is good for plants but not for people who want to go outside.

exercises.title: Complete the sentences with two words from the box to make compound nouns.

sentences.text: A dictionary is useful when you’re in a different country, but a _____ is better because it has complete expressions. – Jake
I always take a _____ because it’s important to drink a lot when you’re travelling. – Lisa
I’ve got very long hair, so I always take a _____ on my trips. – Jenny
We like going camping so a _____ is important to carry our things. It’s better than a suitcase. – Ben
I think a toothbrush is the most important because you need to have clean teeth. But don’t forget the _____! – Ren
I always take a _____ for when it rains. I don’t want to get wet! – Marie
